Summary of websites posted to 'general' channel:

1. informations.com: Latest job report shows unemployment at 7.2%, bringing mixed relief and concern.

2. restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery serving authentic Swiss cuisine. Features traditional dishes like cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. Decor includes wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views through large windows, and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Posted to random channel as requested.

Hi Dora! I checked out your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a clean, minimal site with your email listed. Great start! Consider adding a brief intro, portfolio pieces, or blog posts to give visitors more insight into your work and personality. Looking forward to seeing it grow!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's great that you love hiking! Consider adding some recent hiking trips, photos, or tips to engage readers. You could also categorize posts or add a contact/about page. Looking forward to seeing more content!
